notes.title: Remodels of CA instances
notes.notes: Added in new remodels of CA instances for CA1, CA3, and CA5. This also comes with some slight light changes, handling adjustments, and other minor details that have been adjusted.

notes.title: Remodels of AJ7 instances
notes.notes:
Added in newer models for 3 of the junkyard instances, AJ7-1, AJ7-2 and AJ7-4, pulled from the latest game in the series Junkyard Fury Breakout (feel free to check it out!), as well as making some changes to materials and textures to make it match the original feel.

Also made some material and texture changes to the junkyard environment itself.

notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.notes: Added a new season system that will adjust the original junkyard, as well as the menu, to winter if its December

notes.title: Quick patch - added virtual keyboard
notes.notes: Added virtual keyboard to the mod.io UI, for inputing your email for authentication as well as the code that is sent to you.

notes.title: Mod Support Added!
notes.notes: Mod support has been added, giving people the ability to create their own CA anomaly cases! I will be creating a guide on Steam shortly, but will also link the mod.io page that explains the modding procedure as well. I've also made a mod with the tooling I have created, to showcase what the mod can do! Feel free to check it out!

notes.title: Graphical update, menus
notes.notes:
Added new graphical enhancements, can now change the quality, color intensity, and bloom intensity through the main menu. Also added options in the pause menu that allow you to adjust the sensitivity during game, as well as allowing you to invert controls. 

This also comes with a fix to the pause menu, where it would stay stuck to the screen. Issue should be resolved.

notes.title: CA1 Update
notes.notes: CA1 has been changed, mechanic for the car has been altered. Level is relatively the same, but the mood has been adjusted a bit.

notes.title: AI improvements
notes.notes: AI improvements have been made to the killer cars in the game, which will give them better navigation. Happy Halloween! If you enjoy this title, check out Junkyard Fury 2! JF2 will be coming out 10/28/2022, feel free to check it out on Steam!

notes.title: Cleanups and Visuals
notes.notes:
Visuals have been worked on, including adjusting materials and adding visual flare effects. Slight adjustments to gameplay, death animation has been changed a bit, as well as a few cars that have been adjusted. As of now, this may be the final update of this title, as the sequel is underway. There may be a couple more updates depending on the state of the game or if I can improve the experience of what is there, but this will likely be the last update.

Junkyard Fury 2 is underway, if you would like to check out progress on that title, along with others, I will be posting updates on my twitter @DhoodPro. Thank you for supporting the Junkyard Fury!

notes.title: New Controls
notes.notes:
There are new mechanics to the game. You now have a flashlight you can use, and a stamina bar has been added. This also means the player loses stamina and will get tired. The player does move slightly faster than before as well.

Also, just a reminder that the price will be changing from 1.99 USD to 4.99 USD on 02/10/22

notes.title: Cleanups here and there, Price change coming
notes.notes:
There have been some cleanups here and there, new loading screen. Some of the CA instances have been altered a bit to give a better experience. 

There will be a price change coming. To reach other markets, there is a limit to how low a price can be. Therefore, to stay fair to all markets, it is necessary to adjust the price. The price will go from 1.99 USD to 4.99 USD. This price change will occur on 02/10/2022.

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.notes: A few things were out of order. CA4 had not shown up, that has now been fixed. The conclusion ending showed some glitches, should look better now.

notes.title: Car Anomalies: CA5 / Conclusion
notes.notes: A new car anomaly has been added, giving a new environment and a new vehicle. Conclusion has also been added, which will show the end of the CA series.

notes.title: Car Anomalies: CA4
notes.notes: There has been a new addition to the Car Anomalies, CA4. CA4 brings a new environment and a new vehicle to deal with

notes.title: Quick Patch
notes.notes: A quick patch to the latest update, CA3. Glitch where you fall through the floor shouldn't be an issue anymore

notes.title: Car Anomlies: CA2
notes.notes: CA2 extends the car anomlies section, bringing a new environment and a new mechanic to deal with.

notes.title: Car Anomalies: CA1
notes.notes: Car Anomalies have been added to the game. Car Anomalies cover the smaller cases of killer car that have been found, which all have a combination of different and unique environments and cars. Only one is being released at the moment, CA1. More will be coming in future updates

notes.title: Updated joystick movement, level 4 update
notes.notes: Joystick movement has been worked on. Previously, the left joystick only moved the player forward and back, now it moves the player left and right as well. Level 4 has been updated to make it easier to find where to place ET instances, giving the user a radar that indicates the position (when close)

notes.title: Controls have changed, other small changes
notes.notes:
Controls have been changed to enhance the experience. The controls for PC are relatively the same, but you should now be able to look around vertically as well, and can look behind you. For the optional gamepad, a couple buttons have changed, and the looking mechanics for it have changed as well. The control page when you load in will show the new controls.

Other small changes to the environment, some cars have been modified (in terms of looks).

notes.title: AJ7-3 change
notes.notes: AJ7-3 has been changed. The original car was a newer model car, which didn't really fit the story line of the game. AJ7-3 is now displayed as an older model car. It performs the same way, just has a different look.

notes.title: Quick patch, other changes
notes.notes: Quick patch to the menus. There was a glitch that would prevent the second menu from popping up under certain circumstances, should be patched now. Some environmental changes, touched up a few mechanics

notes.title: Quick patch, small changes
notes.notes: There has been a quick patch to AJ7-2 in terms of response. AJ7-2 originally read mouse input when staying still, but in a previous update, it was taken out by accident. AJ7-2 now reads mouse input again. Other small changes, environmental and adjusted lighting

notes.title: Small update to menus
notes.notes: Quick update for the menus, specifically if a player wins the normal ending, but not the secret ending, they'll be given the menu that allows them to play previous levels, just with the secret level locked. Made more sense to adjust it this way.

notes.title: Update 10/09/2021, Graphic changes
notes.notes: Graphics have been worked on, added a high quality setting with intended effects

notes.title: Minor Changes, AJ7-2 explained better
notes.notes: The description of AJ7-2's behavior was not accurately described, it's behavior is now described more thoroughly. Some other minor mapping changes have been made as well.
